Rust preserves the pinned Node URL-like recognition property order, original recognition errors, ordinary string coercion, original input inspection on conversion errors and the canonical file-URL path converter. Invalid value errors use the captured internal inspector, preserve 128 UTF-16 code-unit truncation and direct coded TypeError presentation. Complete URL query metadata and full Module constructor/resolution/global lookup hooks remain open.

Ancestor node_modules search directories have one Rust projection shared by ordinary CJS module records and the public adapter. The public operation calls the existing path resolver with original receiver and input, preserving hooks and errors.

Three exact Node comparisons cover original property hooks, errors, Unicode/directory bases, constructor calls, global URL overrides, public resolver hooks and guest cwd. Thin checked function facades provide ordinary callable/constructor presentation; Rust retains policy.

pathToFileURL now uses the canonical public POSIX/Win32 resolver, original cwd and trailing separator; its old fixture-relative remapping is removed. Shared path argument errors derive their received description from the Node utility authority. The search-path reduction removes an intermediate vector.
